## Behavior

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

Include the exact command, Node/OS versions, and a minimal synthetic input. State whether this was preview, replay, baseline, or live mode.

## Evidence

Attach sanitized errors and report metadata. Never include API keys, .env contents, or private tickets. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md instead.

## Verification

Which tests or commands did you run? Can the failure be reproduced without a paid request?
